images.alt: Explosive demolition of the Boardman coal plant smokestack showing a massive plume of dust and debris as the 656-foot tower collapses in September 2022.
images.caption: Explosive demolition of the Boardman coal plant's 656-foot smokestack in September 2022. The controlled detonation marked the physical end of Oregon's coal-fired power generation era.
